pouchMaterials.name: Domestic Polyethylene (LDPE/LLDPE) Zipper Bag
pouchMaterials.delaminationType: Monolayer thermal creep, seam peeling & micro-void formation
pouchMaterials.chemicalMigrationRisk: High (PE cyclic oligomers, slip agent erucamide, antioxidant degradation products)
pouchMaterials.foodContactStandard: FDA 21 CFR 177.1520 approved for ambient/freezer; NOT certified for high-temp immersion (>75°C)
pouchMaterials.description: Standard household zipper freezer bag. At water bath temperatures above 80°C, the amorphous phase of LDPE softens precipitously, leading to polymer chain relaxation, seam peeling under hydrostatic steam pressure, and microplastic particle detachment.

pouchMaterials.name: Commercial Multi-Layer (PA/PE) Vacuum Pouch
pouchMaterials.delaminationType: Interlayer tie-layer polyurethane/adhesive hydrolysis under prolonged immersion
pouchMaterials.chemicalMigrationRisk: Compliant with EU 10/2011 OML (<10 mg/dm² under standard conditions; increases in oil bath)
pouchMaterials.foodContactStandard: EU Regulation (EU) No 10/2011 & FDA 21 CFR 177.1500 / 177.1520 compliant up to 85°C
pouchMaterials.description: Co-extruded vacuum pouch with external biaxially oriented polyamide (Nylon 6) for mechanical barrier strength and internal LLDPE for heat sealing. Robust for standard meat sous vide, but water vapor permeability at >85°C can weaken polyurethane tie-layers over >12h dwells.

pouchMaterials.name: High-Barrier Retort Polypropylene (CPP/BOPA) Pouch
pouchMaterials.polymerClass: Biaxially Oriented Polyamide / Cast Polypropylene Laminate
pouchMaterials.delaminationType: Negligible under sous vide (engineered for pressurized retort autoclaves)
pouchMaterials.chemicalMigrationRisk: Ultra-low (<1.5 mg/dm²; well below 10 mg/dm² EU threshold)
pouchMaterials.foodContactStandard: FDA 21 CFR 177.1390 & EU 10/2011 Certified for High-Temperature Boil-in-Bag & Retort Sterilization
pouchMaterials.description: Industrial-grade boil-in-bag pouch utilizing cast polypropylene (CPP) with a thermal ceiling exceeding 121°C. The crystalline polypropylene structure resists softening, completely preventing seal creep during high-heat root vegetable braising.

pouchMaterials.name: Reusable Platinum-Cured Food-Grade Silicone Bag
pouchMaterials.microplasticSheddingRate85C: Near-Zero (<50 particles/dm²; no thermoplastic microplastic fragmentation)
pouchMaterials.chemicalMigrationRisk: Negligible (BPA-free, phthalate-free, non-thermoplastic; trace D4/D5 siloxanes <0.05 mg/kg)
pouchMaterials.foodContactStandard: FDA 21 CFR 177.2600 & German LFGB § 30/31 Food Contact Certified
pouchMaterials.description: Monolithic platinum-cured silicone with cross-linked siloxane bonds (Si-O-Si). Completely immune to thermal softening, delamination, or seam creep at boiling water temperatures, making it the safest reusable option for high-heat sous vide cooking.

pouchMaterials.name: Plasticized PVC / Low-Grade Multipurpose Wrap
pouchMaterials.polymerClass: Polyvinyl Chloride with Monomeric Plasticizers (DEHP / DINP / Adipates)
pouchMaterials.delaminationType: Rapid structural softening, embrittlement & seam detachment
pouchMaterials.chemicalMigrationRisk: Severe Hazard (Massive lipophilic plasticizer leaching: 45–120 mg/dm² into hot oils)
pouchMaterials.foodContactStandard: PROHIBITED for high-temperature fatty food contact under EU 10/2011 & FDA regulations
pouchMaterials.description: Cheap plasticized PVC wrap or utility bags. When submerged in hot water baths containing fats or oils, plasticizers rapidly diffuse across the concentration gradient, leaching endocrine-disrupting phthalates and microplastics directly into food.

bathTemperatures.name: 55°C (131°F) - Medium-Rare Steak & Delicate Fish
bathTemperatures.typicalApplication: Beef tenderloin, salmon, chicken breast at lower temperatures

bathTemperatures.name: 65°C (149°F) - Medium Poultry & Custards
bathTemperatures.typicalApplication: Whole poultry legs, egg yolks, pork chops

bathTemperatures.name: 75°C (167°F) - Collagen Breakdown & Pork Confit
bathTemperatures.polymerSofteningState: Approaching LDPE Vicat softening threshold; pouch pressure rises
bathTemperatures.typicalApplication: Pork belly, beef short ribs, tough connective tissue breakdown

bathTemperatures.name: 85°C (185°F) - Root Vegetables & Pectin Dissolution
bathTemperatures.polymerSofteningState: Exceeds LDPE Vicat point; significant amorphous chain relaxation

bathTemperatures.name: 92°C (198°F) - High-Temp Starch Gelatinization & Legumes
bathTemperatures.polymerSofteningState: Severe thermal creep zone; domestic PE seams vulnerable to failure
bathTemperatures.typicalApplication: Dry beans, whole grain pulses, fibrous winter squash

cookDurations.name: 1 Hour (Rapid vegetable or fish cycle)
cookDurations.typicalUse: Quick tender vegetable blanching or delicate fish fillet

cookDurations.name: 4 Hours (Standard root vegetable braise)
cookDurations.typicalUse: Glazed carrots, sous vide potato fondants, tenderized beets

cookDurations.name: 12 Hours (Overnight braise & confit)
cookDurations.typicalUse: Overnight pork shoulder, duck leg confit, braised ox cheeks

cookDurations.name: 24 Hours (Extended collagen hydrolysis)
cookDurations.typicalUse: 48-hour brisket, beef shank, long-term restaurant prep

cookDurations.name: 48 Hours (Ultra-long low-temperature pasteurization)
cookDurations.typicalUse: Extreme modernist culinary confits & tough game meats

sealGeometries.name: Single 1mm Thermal Wire Impulse Seal (Entry-level domestic sealer)
sealGeometries.description: Narrow single wire seal prone to localized micro-thinning, air bubble voids, and rapid mechanical peeling under internal vapor pressure.

sealGeometries.name: Standard 3mm Flat Heating Band Seal (Mid-tier external suction sealer)
sealGeometries.description: Wider flat sealing ribbon providing balanced bonded area. Reliable for standard sous vide under 80°C, but susceptible to peel creep at >85°C.

sealGeometries.name: Dual 5mm Industrial Chamber Impulse Seal (Commercial chamber vacuum machine)
sealGeometries.description: Double wide impulse seal bars fused under pneumatic chamber pressure. Excellent contact area and zero bubble inclusion, resisting internal steam expansion.

sealGeometries.name: Mechanical Press-to-Close Interlocking Zipper (Domestic freezer bag)
sealGeometries.description: Mechanical male-female interlocking profile relying on friction. Hydrostatic steam and vegetable outgassing force the profile open when water softens the polymer.

foodMatrices.name: Aqueous Low-Acid Food (Water, stock, lean poultry, carrots)
foodMatrices.description: Standard water-based cooking matrix. Plasticizer and additive migration governed primarily by water solubility and temperature.

foodMatrices.name: Lipid-Rich Oil / Butter Bath (Duck confit, butter-poached lobster, pork belly)
foodMatrices.description: High triglyceride and lipid content acts as an organic solvent. Non-polar plastic additives, oligomers, and phthalates partition up to 4–5x more readily into the dietary lipid phase.

foodMatrices.name: Acidic Marinade / Glaze (Citrus, red wine reduction, tomato, pH < 3.5)
foodMatrices.description: Low pH aqueous environment accelerates acid-catalyzed hydrolysis of polyurethane tie-layer adhesives in multi-layer barrier laminates, promoting pouch delamination.
